inputData.notes: Routine evening sweep prior to night shift crane hoisting.

findings.summary: Potential fall hazard identified: Missing intermediate guardrail wire and loose timber debris near floor edge opening.

hazards.description: Mid-rail wire was found slackened near column B-4; unbolted 4x4 timber boards within 18 inches of unenclosed floor perimeter.
hazards.evidence: Perimeter cable sagged below OSHA 39-45 inch compliance mark; loose debris vulnerable to wind displacement.
hazards.recommended_action: Tension wire rope clips immediately, install 3.5 inch toeboard, clear loose scrap timber to designated bin.

limitations: Analysis conducted on visible daylight photos. Thermal or night-vision conditions not evaluated.

recommendations: Install OSHA-compliant yellow mesh toeboards along entire West perimeter.
Hold 15-minute tool-box safety talk with masonry subcontractor tomorrow at 07:00 AM.

findings.summary: Diagonal shear crack identified on concrete cantilever bracket. Width approximately 0.4mm.
findings.observations: Crack pattern consistent with cyclic dynamic truck loading. No active water seepage or exposed efflorescence detected.
recommendations: Install Demec crack monitoring pins to measure dynamic displacement over 30 days.
Pressure-inject low-viscosity structural epoxy (ASTM C881 Type IV).
Consult licensed bridge structural engineer for verification against AASHTO LRFD specifications.
limitations: Subsurface delamination cannot be determined from optical photo without ultrasonic pulse testing.
